course.title: Unit 7 A Day to Remember【例句】
course.description: Section A What was your special day like?

sentences.content: Where are the students in the photo?
sentences.english: Where are the students in the photo ?
sentences.chinese: 照片里的学生们在哪里？

sentences.content: What are they doing?
sentences.english: What are they doing ?
sentences.chinese: 他们在做什么？

sentences.content: Are they working hard?
sentences.english: Are they working hard ?
sentences.chinese: 他们工作努力吗？

sentences.content: Would you like to try this kind of work?
sentences.english: Would you like to try this kind of work ?
sentences.chinese: 你想试试这种工作吗？

sentences.content: How was Peter’s weekend?
sentences.english: How was Peter's weekend ?
sentences.chinese: Peter的周末过得怎么样？

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: It was great!
sentences.english: It was great !
sentences.chinese: 太棒了！

sentences.content: What did Peter like about the museum?
sentences.english: What did Peter like about the museum ?
sentences.chinese: Peter喜欢这个博物馆的什么地方？

wordDetails.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

sentences.content: There was a space exhibition.
sentences.english: There was a space exhibition
sentences.chinese: 曾举办过一场太空展览。

sentences.content: There were some special rooms,
sentences.english: There were some special rooms
sentences.chinese: 这里有一些特别的房间,

sentences.content: and they looked like parts of a space station.
sentences.english: and they looked like parts of a space station
sentences.chinese: 它们看起来像是空间站的部件。

sentences.content: You could go inside them and see how astronauts live and work!
sentences.english: You could go inside them and see how astronauts live and work !
sentences.chinese: 你可以进入其中，看看宇航员们是如何生活和工作的！

sentences.content: How was Teng Fei’s weekend?
sentences.english: How was Teng Fei's weekend ?
sentences.chinese: Teng Fei的周末过得怎么样？

sentences.content: It was terrible!
sentences.english: It was terrible !
sentences.chinese: 太糟糕了！

sentences.content: How did Teng Fei feel after he talked to the tourists?
sentences.english: How did Teng Fei feel after he talked to the tourists ?
sentences.chinese: 滕飞与游客交谈后感觉如何？

wordDetails.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

sentences.content: He felt bad.
sentences.english: He felt bad
sentences.chinese: 他感到难受。

sentences.content: Hi, Fu Xing. How was your school trip to the wastewater plant?
sentences.english: Hi , Fu Xing . How was your school trip to the wastewater plant ?
sentences.chinese: 嗨，Fu Xing。你们学校组织的污水处理厂参观活动怎么样？

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: Was it boring?
sentences.english: Was it boring ?
sentences.chinese: 无聊吗？

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: No, it wasn’t at all.
sentences.english: No , it wasn't at all
sentences.chinese: 不，一点也不。

sentences.content: It was really interesting!
sentences.english: It was really interesting !
sentences.chinese: 这真有趣！

sentences.content: We saw the plant make dirty water clean again.
sentences.english: We saw the plant make dirty water clean again
sentences.chinese: 我们目睹了这家工厂将污水净化如初。

sentences.content: Well, first, water from our homes goes into the plant.
sentences.english: Well , first , water from our homes goes into the plant
sentences.chinese: 首先，我们家庭排放的污水会进入处理厂。

wordDetails.definition: go（第三人称单数现在时）: 去

sentences.content: Then, special screens remove large pieces of waste from the water.
sentences.english: Then , special screens remove large pieces of waste from the water
sentences.chinese: 随后，专用筛网会从水中清除大块废物。

sentences.content: Well, machines remove germs and other things from the water.
sentences.english: Well , machines remove germs and other things from the water
sentences.chinese: 嗯，机器会去除水中的细菌和其他杂质。

sentences.content: These things are usually too small to see.
sentences.english: These things are usually too small to see
sentences.chinese: 这些东西通常小到看不见。

sentences.content: It takes a few more steps after that before the water becomes clean again.
sentences.english: It takes a few more steps after that before the water becomes clean again
sentences.chinese: 之后还需要经过几个步骤，水才能再次变得干净。

wordDetails.definition: take（第三人称单数）: 需要
become（第三人称单数）: 变得

sentences.content: Wow! I used to think it was easy to get clean water.
sentences.english: Wow ! I used to think it was easy to get clean water
sentences.chinese: 哇！我以前还以为获取干净的水很容易呢。

sentences.content: Me too! I didn’t realize it was so hard.
sentences.english: Me too ! I didn't realize it was so hard
sentences.chinese: 我也是！我没想到会这么难。
